title: Reflect flat-term K-flat complexes from the coefficient point site
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and P an unbounded integer cochain complex of A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Realize it as a complex of modules over the sheafified constant ring on the discrete one-object site with bottom topology [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. If this realization is K-flat for the independent-coefficients test [def-pc-kflat-complex] and every realized term is flat on that site [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then P is categorically K-flat and every Pⁿ is categorically flat.

source.place: Tags 03CY, 06YS and 06YN; specialization to the one-object bottom-topology site.

proof.text: Bottom-topology sheafification is an isomorphism. Its constant-ring comparison transports the realization to the literal constant module complex. Transport preserves and reflects flatness and the acyclic-tensor K-flat test.

Evaluation at the unique object is an exact tensor equivalence. Apply it to each flat term and each acyclic-tensor test. The cone criterion identifies the latter with preservation of quasi-isomorphisms in both tensor orders.

    (hf : ∀ n, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite

      (R := realizationRing (⊥ : GrothendieckTopology (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) A)
        ((pointRealization A).obj (P.X n))) :

      ∀ n, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X n)
